newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Wonlim says selling off shrs.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Wonlim says selling off shrs.

text.p: South Korea's Wonlim Corp, a textile maker, said on Friday it will sell 65,100 shares of its own common stock to raise working capital.
After the sell-off, the company will not hold any of its own shares.
The sales, representing 2.96 percent of its share capital, will take place between January 7 and April 7, a company statement said.
The statement said the shares would be sold on the open market at the previous day's closing price.
Wonlim's shares closed Friday's trading 1,000 won higher at 14,500.
